statements.status_notes: CVE-2012-5783 involves improper SSL certificate hostname validation in commons-httpclient. commons-httpclient 3.0.1 is a transitive dependency (via Hadoop) and is not used by Cassandra to make HTTPS connections. Cassandra uses Netty for inter-node TLS communication (ports 7000/7001) and the CQL native transport, neither of which relies on commons-httpclient.
